name: xoga750-fix3-gpc-counter-reset-dev
description: DEV ONLY. Puts the GPC trade id counter back to 54983 so the next GPC Trade run starts again at TR-FY-2026-54984, the first id of the old Opera dump. Use it before each repeat of the GPC retest: every run moves the counter up by the number of rows (319 for the test files). Only the GPC counter row created by rule xoga750-fix2 is changed; the precondition stops the rule if that row is missing or is someone else's row.

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.oga_transaction_id_sequence_criteria WHERE {{where}} AND created_by = 'xoga750-gpc'
preconditions.reason: exactly one GPC counter row and it is the one created by fix 2
